heading: INT. ABANDONED SALT MINE - SHAFT STATION - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ABANDONED SALT MINE - SHAFT STATION - NIGHT
White crystal walls glitter under a dying headlamp.
A field radio sits on an overturned crate, its dial glowing orange.
A YOUNG SOLDIER (19, helmet too big, canteen empty) kneels beside the radio and turns the dial.
He wipes salt from his lips with the back of his hand.
He picks up the handset, puts it down, picks it up again, and finally presses the key.
Any station, any station. This is Almeida. Come in.
units.name: YOUNG SOLDIER

units.text: A burst of static answers.
Then a woman's voice, patient and far away.
Almeida, this is Command. Say your position.
units.name: COMMAND

units.text: Mine shaft, level four. I'm alone. The others went up at dusk and haven't come back.
units.name: ALMEIDA

units.text: Understood, Private. Do you have water?
units.name: COMMAND

units.text: No. A little. Not enough.
units.name: ALMEIDA

units.text: He crawls to the shaft opening, peers up into the dark, then scrambles back, knocks over the crate, catches the radio before it hits the floor, and sets it upright while the headlamp flickers.
Private Almeida, listen. The extraction was cancelled at noon. I'm sorry.
units.name: COMMAND

units.text: Almeida slides down the wall to the floor.
He lets the handset rest on his knee.
Cancelled.
units.name: ALMEIDA

units.text: I'll stay on the line as long as you want.
units.name: COMMAND

units.text: Almeida closes his eyes.
The headlamp goes out.
The radio dial keeps glowing.
